mechanics.claim: The orb deals magic damage on the way out and true damage on the way back, each pass hitting an enemy only once.
mechanics.quote: deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies it passes through. Upon reaching maximum range, it returns to her to deal the same amount in {{sti|{{as|true damage}}}} to enemies it passes through.

mechanics.claim: Each enemy can only be hit once per pass (once outgoing, once returning).
mechanics.quote: Each pass of the projectile can only damage an enemy once.

mechanics.claim: The orb hits additional units around the return point in a small circle when it turns around, and the initial missile still only damages a unit once there.
mechanics.quote: ''Orb of Deception'' will hit additional units around the return point in a small circle when the orb turns around.

mechanics.claim: Damage is recalculated dynamically based on Ahri's current stats rather than locked at cast time.
mechanics.quote: This ability's damage is calculated based on the caster's current stats and changes dynamically.
